name: local-failover-one-way-a-b
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). At 12 s frames from A to B stop arriving while B stays alive and A still hears B. A timeout alone would never fire; A fails over when B stops being two-way (T1) or when sends to B fail (T2).
